entries.rationale: If a script is marked #!/bin/sh, it must not use double brackets or other Bash-only syntax. SS QLM mandates strictly checking the shebang against the features used.

entries.good_example: if (( BASH_VERSINFO[0] < 4 )); then echo "Error: Bash 4.0+ required"; exit 1; fi
entries.rationale: Features like associative arrays or case-conversion (${var,,}) require Bash 4.0+. SS QLM requires an explicit version check to prevent obscure syntax errors on older systems.
